'''Adamant alloy''' replaces the netherite ingot. It is crafted from 4 [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]], 4 gold ingots and a [[Divine Fragment|divine fragment]], and upgrades diamond gear into [[Adamant equipment|adamant]]. Adamant (and electrum) equipment blasts back into one alloy.
